resources.string: Choose a language for this app. Your Android language stays the same.
Language, appearance and help, in one place.
Independent, open-source software for managing official Motorola updates. Not affiliated with Motorola, Lenovo or Magisk.
Learn the update steps, root permissions and safety checks.
Diagnostic reports are shared only when you export them. Online update checks and downloads use Motorola servers after you allow them.
Your next update, in one place
Check your Motorola, find official firmware and follow every step with a clear view of root and update progress.
English and Dutch, light and dark

On supported A/B devices: verify the official update, preserve a backup, restore the matching stock boot image, install the OTA, prepare Magisk on the next slot and restart. The app checks which steps your device can run.
The app checks what your device supports
One clear start approval for the whole update
A completed download is not an installed update
You can explore the app without root. Full diagnostics and partition preparation need Magisk access. Grant Moto OTA Manager access in Magisk → Superuser when you are ready.
No automatic root request during setup
Your modules and root policy are preserved
Try the full workflow with safe test files
Keep a separate backup of important files. Read the complete update plan before starting. The app checks each step and restarts only within the update route you approved.
No factory reset or bootloader locking
Unknown or conflicting evidence blocks writes
Only a new boot and final checks confirm success
An interrupted partition write is never repeated automatically.
A safe place to try the workflow
Every device observation is simulated. Stock restore writes only small files in the app cache. Your real partitions and update journal are separate.
Simulation complete: stock, OTA, Magisk, reboot and merge.
Stock restore or the update is still in progress. Keep the current root session running. Open Update to check the next step.
Check the new boot, root and snapshot merge before starting another update.
Software, root and update status at a glance.
Device checks passed. Check for a suitable official update next.
Android properties differ from the kernel boot data. Root modules can change reported values. Kernel evidence is used for the boot state.
Find and verify official Motorola firmware.
Check Motorola for your current device and software channel.

Online checks send your serial number, build-context GUID, model, channel, build, fingerprint, Android version, language and hardware information to Motorola. They stay out of reports. Turning this off stops future online checks; the monitor can still inspect local metadata.
Device identifiers are used only for this request. The app does not include them in shared reports.
No update offered for this request
The server result could not be confirmed
Allow online checks to contact Motorola
This server route is not available for the detected region
Could not reach Motorola. Check your connection and try again.
Motorola did not accept this request. Try its system updater.
A server offer is not a verified package. The downloaded bytes still need the full firmware checks.
Read an existing ZIP from Motorola’s app folder without changing the original file.
Optional periodic checks use the same consent and device checks. Android schedules the work. An available update is reported before any installation starts.
Notifications are off. Results remain available in the app.
Choose an official A/B ZIP. The app checks its structure, source firmware, payload hashes and device-trusted signature.
A verified package still needs source, target, slot and update-engine checks before installation.
Import a boot or init_boot image, or a Magisk gzip backup. Its complete bytes must match authenticated firmware and the running Magisk installation before a write can be allowed.
Magisk could not be opened. Grant Moto OTA Manager access in Magisk → Superuser, then return here.
No accessible Motorola update screen was found. Open System updates from Android Settings.
Android did not allow this screen to open. Open the official app from your launcher.

Grant Moto OTA Manager root access in Magisk → Superuser. This check reads device properties, slots, snapshots, update status, backups and module inventory. It does not install, restore or restart anything.
Review the plan, then follow your update.
Check Motorola → download and verify → back up the patched image → restore stock → install OTA → prepare Magisk → restart after checks.
By starting, you approve the required partition writes, OTA installation, Magisk preparation and restart for this update. There are no separate confirmations later.

The check shares your serial number, build GUID, firmware and device details, channel and language with Motorola. Keep a separate backup of important files and do not restart manually while the update is running.
Automatic updates require a positively identified Motorola with a supported A/B layout.
Find, download and verify official firmware
Back up and restore the matching stock image
Prepare Magisk on the target slot
Restart, check root and finish the merge
Use these tools for a stopped or manually managed update. They do not turn an incomplete step into a confirmed result. Read the diagnostics before changing anything.
Check unchanged source for a new plan
This manual action writes only the partition and stock hash shown above. A full patched backup is made first. Keep the current root session running until the OTA and Magisk steps are complete.
Check conditions for a Magisk retry
This separate local transfer may make Motorola recognize a package immediately. It needs an authenticated signed channel and never proves installation.
A clearer view of your device
Inspect measured evidence and export a report you can choose to share.
Reports contain only basic technical details. No IMEI, serial number, boot ID, accounts, module IDs, raw logs or signed URLs are included. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
%1$d observed; functional compatibility is not proven
Failure counters are read only. A zero count does not guarantee a future update offer.
No readable backup was found. This does not prove that no backup exists.
Update confirmed; stock backup needs review
Return to the previous slot detected
Start with a read-only device check.
The simulation stopped. Your real workflow is unchanged. You can start a new simulation.
Root access is unavailable. Grant Moto OTA Manager access in Magisk → Superuser, then try again.
Device check complete. Only fresh observations confirm update progress.
These device values are simulated. Your real update journal is unchanged.
Stock restoration uses small cache files. OTA, Magisk, restart and merge are simulated.
Copying the package and calculating its complete hash. This can take several minutes.
Reading the Motorola package into private app storage…
Package inspected. Its official signature must also be verified before any update action.
Download queued. Progress is saved so it can be paused and resumed.
Restore plan prepared. The partition has not been written.
Rechecking the signed package before transferring it to Motorola…
The complete package was copied and its hash checked. This does not confirm Motorola recognition or installation.
The diagnostic report was saved locally. Nothing was uploaded.
The complete patched recovery image was exported after checking its size and hash. No partition was restored.
No complete readable ZIP was found in Motorola’s app folder. An update may still be streamed or offered by the server.
Local Motorola packages found. Choose one to inspect without changing the source.
The signature or package identity could not be verified. Update preparation remains blocked.
The complete package signature and stable bytes are verified. Authenticated image evidence was saved; current-device checks still apply.
The package signature is verified. No matching stock-image evidence could be saved; installation eligibility remains a separate check.
The complete current stock image matches authenticated firmware evidence.
Image saved locally. Restoration is blocked until current stock provenance is proven.
Background checks enabled. Android schedules them; online requests follow your sharing preference.
Checking the file size with the server.
A complete download still needs firmware and signature verification.
Only durably saved bytes are resumed. The file restarts if its server identity cannot be confirmed.
This address is not an allowed Motorola download host. Use a current official offer or import a package.
The connection was interrupted. Resume when connected again.
The server refused the request. The link may have expired; check Motorola again.
The server redirected the download. Check for a fresh official offer.
The server did not provide a reliable file length. Use a fresh offer or import the package.
The response did not match the saved download. Resume starts safely from the beginning.
The server file changed. Resume starts a new copy.
There is not enough free space. Keep space for the rest of the file plus a 256 MiB reserve.
This package exceeds the 12 GiB download limit.
The complete hash did not match. The package was not selected; resume downloads a fresh copy.
The saved download state is invalid. Cancel it and start a new download.
The saved private link could not be opened. Cancel and check for a fresh official offer.
The selected package changed during the download and was preserved.
The file could not be read or saved safely. Check free storage and try again.
Temporary download bytes were removed. An earlier selected package is preserved.
Android could not start the visible download task. Open the app and resume.
Checking the device and the official update offer…
Verifying the complete package and stock evidence…
Preparing the payload and verified Magisk tools…
Restoring and reading back the current stock image. Do not restart.
Android is applying the official OTA. Do not restart.
Preparing and verifying Magisk on the updated inactive slot…
Verifying both slots before the authorized restart…
Waiting for the new boot, root and merge checks.
Automation stopped. Read the diagnostics before continuing.
Allow device data for update checks
Motorola did not return a new downloadable OTA for this request. Try later or open System updates.
The official server selection could not be proved for this device and target. No update is started.
Automatic root preservation requires the original, visible Magisk 31.1 app with verified official tools. Use the guided route if your manager is hidden or different.
This Magisk configuration cannot be patched safely by the automatic adapter. Keep the current boot and use the guided route.
The inactive-slot write is incomplete or unconfirmed. Do not restart or repeat it. Inspect the saved images and diagnostics.
Android could not safely prepare or complete the OTA handoff. Read the workflow state and diagnostics before continuing.
The update authorization is missing, expired or no longer matches this run. An interrupted write is never replayed.
